_source: CHR 7.24.5 x86 MAC-Telnet console screens, captured 2026-11-26 over the L2 bridge (test/integration/mactelnet-l2-bridge.ts) with MacTelnetConsole.run() at the default 512 columns, during the review of #676 (#575). `command` is the exact text passed to run(); `raw` is the console's reply; `expected` is the command's output as the screen shows it (verified by hand: the echo, TAB completion lists and prompt redraws removed). In `wrap short output 473` and `474` the redraw fills the 512-column row, so the console wraps once more before the CRLF + CR that ends the echo; read on the screen alone, that wrap looked like a blank output line. Entries labelled `re-check:` are a second CHR 7.24.5 session (2026-11-26, same bridge and width) for the second review of #676: printed text that looks like the next command, ends with the command's own tail, looks like a prompt or a `{... ` continuation; repeated silent lines; a TAB-only line; a tail repeated at the wrap boundary; and `:put ""`. Their `expected` is the device output, set before the capture.
